verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships as a TypeScript-first library with documented 'full IntelliSense' support and generated TypeDoc API references, which gives coding-agent editors typed definitions to attach to via the standard TypeScript language server rather than a custom Babylon-specific LSP. This satisfies the 'typed API definitions' branch of the story but not a dedicated official LSP, and there's no independent hands-on confirmation of completion/diagnostic quality. Missing for 10: an official Babylon-specific language server, independent corroboration of TypeScript IntelliSense fidelity in real editors, and evidence of navigation/diagnostics beyond generic TS tooling.
